image_prompt.text: Dense clusters of repeating rooftop props scattered across the floor to break sightlines during the chase — AC units and air-conditioning boxes of varying sizes, plus stacked crates to hide and dodge behind
Low parapet walls running around the rooftop edge, acting as railings and barriers
A couple of elevated platforms at different heights, standing on the rooftop floor as vantage points
Ramps connecting the different height levels so players can run up and down between them
A small rooftop shed / penthouse structure set clear of the walls so players can run all the way around it
A large flat urban building rooftop, blocky and stylized, built in concrete and metal

notes: Preset caveat: took Childhood Game and kept its shape space-continuous, but dropped obstacle-maze — the prompt asks for one large flat rooftop surface with scattered cover, not a warren of rooms and corridors — which also drops that option's P6.
Preset caveat: dropped social-hub as well; the prompt describes no lobby or staging area, and space-continuous already makes the rooftop itself the gathering space.
The raised platforms and connecting ramps are tiered elevation with nothing overhanging, so the route stays P0. If the platforms are meant to overhang the floor below, that is P2 and not ready yet.
The shed / penthouse is something players run around, not into, so no building-interior and no P3. If it should be enterable, that needs interiors generated separately and is not ready yet.

Not layout geometry: the requested configurable attributes (floor size, wall height, number of AC units, crate count, platform height) are script-level tunables the layout handoff cannot carry. No exact quantities were stated for any pick — "several", "a few", "a couple", "some" — so no count fields are set.
"Battle arena" is scene dressing here; the described gameplay is tag/chase with no combat, so Action was not named as a second genre and party-casual's Childhood Game preset covers it.

would have asked: Sounds like a childhood tag game on one continuous rooftop — the whole roof is the play space, with dense clusters of AC units and stacked crates breaking sightlines, low parapet walls round the edge, a couple of raised platforms linked by ramps, and a shed to circle. No hide-and-seek maze and no separate lobby, since you described one open roof. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: the two Core options you do not already have — a lobby / staging area, and a leaderboard wall. I left both out. Shape needed no question: "a rooftop arena for a tag game" already answered it as one continuous space.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
